translations.web: Then I sent to him, saying, “There are no such things done as you say, but you imagine them out of your own heart.”
translations.bsb: Then I sent him this reply: “There is nothing to these rumors you are spreading; you are inventing them in your own mind.”
translations.kjv: Then I sent unto him, saying, There are no such things done as thou sayest, but thou feignest them out of thine own heart.
